description: This file defines the EmpLocations entity class, which models the relationship between employees and locations in the OrangeHRM system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping, with properties for Employee and Location, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: EmpLocations
classes.description: Entity class representing the employee locations, establishing many-to-one relationships with Employee and Location entities, and mapping to the hs_hr_emp_locations database table.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this location record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this location record.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the Location associated with this employee.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the Location for this employee.
